Messages.Author: hamdamcwa
Messages.Body:
1) Meth A uses his Joquina to rush his Gratiano

Meth B does not block and does not Obedience

Meth A immediately plays Illusions of the Kindred. He pulls out...
Jimmy Dunn.

Jimmy Dunn hits for 3 at close range

Gratiano plays Shadow Body

Can the Dunn-ster now play Psyche! or is he a fading image before he
gets the chance?

2) What do you get hanging from apple trees?

3) Is there any timing restriction on when you can tap the Vagabond
Mystic? e.g. Ghouled Street Thug hits for 3 using Pushing the Limits
and is about to get hit for one. Can the VM be tapped in between the
GST's strike and the other minions strike?

Regards

DH

Messages.Author: The Lasombra
Messages.Body:
On 12 Jun 2002 04:37:48 -0700, (hamdamcwa) asked:

>1) Meth A uses his Joquina to rush his Gratiano
>Meth B does not block and does not Obedience
>Meth A immediately plays Illusions of the Kindred. He pulls out...
>Jimmy Dunn.
>Jimmy Dunn hits for 3 at close range
>Gratiano plays Shadow Body
>Can the Dunn-ster now play Psyche! or is he a fading image before he
>gets the chance?

He burns as soon as Combat Ends, which is before he can play Psyche!

LSJ 2001-06-21
http://groups.google.com/groups?selm=3B31CFEB.60BB5EA6%40white-wolf.com

>2) What do you get hanging from apple trees?

Apple pollen all over your clothes, or dead if you hang too long.

>3) Is there any timing restriction on when you can tap the Vagabond
>Mystic? e.g. Ghouled Street Thug hits for 3 using Pushing the Limits
>and is about to get hit for one. Can the VM be tapped in between the
>GST's strike and the other minions strike?

The Vagabond Mystic can be tapped between the announcement of the
strikes and the damage resolution of those strikes. The Vagabond
Mystic cannot be tapped during damage resolution, ie to regain 1 life
in the middle of resolving damage for a multiple damage strike.

LSJ 2000-11-11
